replacements.before:
List/canvas/tree native identities, generation and scope are checked
against owner publication by the bound fixture.
replacements.after:
ListBox checks require ordinary native host/row identities, accepted values
and clipping. Tree/canvas checks additionally require current generation and
scope against owner publication by the bound fixture.

replacements.before:
Clipboard access and preference changes are disabled
and reported false by the fixture; global OS state is outside this observation.
replacements.after:
The fixture requests no general clipboard or OS preference changes and
explicitly disables window geometry persistence. Its reported false clipboard/
preference flags do not independently observe global OS state.
